description.value:
Frequency once per day

Target up to 2 creatures, one shot each, no MAP between them

Effect both shots that hit count as critical hits and deal an extra 3d8 damage

Fire both pistols at up to two different targets as a single perfect action.

cinderfall.incomplete: two-target no-MAP shot, both hits auto-crit +3d8. (auto-crit matches the pre-confirmed "no rule element manufactures a critical success" absence). This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This is a cross-creature effect: it changes a DIFFERENT creature's own roll, HP, condition, healing, or item from the actor's own passive or activated ability, with no companion linked Effect item in this corpus to carry it (unlike the six real *-effect cards this class does have). No selector exists for this anywhere in pf2e-source.
